findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 224 requests to 62 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

27 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), cloudflareinsights.com (Cloudflare, analytics), confiant-integrations.net (Confiant, advertising), crwdcntrl.net (Lotame, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising).
6 cookies were set by third-party domains (33 cookies in total).
A script served from dualping.com read image data from a canvas element. This API is also used for legitimate purposes and does not by itself indicate tracking.
